# Read-only, metadata-only AWS CLI commands for prerequisite-validator.
# Mirrors infra/cloudformation/prerequisite-validator/prerequisite-validator-role.yml.
# Note: no `ssm get-parameter`/`secretsmanager get-secret-value` (values).
Bash(aws ssm describe-parameters *)
Bash(aws ssm get-parameters --names /aws/service/*)
Bash(aws secretsmanager describe-secret *)
Bash(aws secretsmanager list-secrets *)
Bash(aws ec2 describe-availability-zones *)
Bash(aws ec2 describe-images *)
Bash(aws ec2 describe-key-pairs *)
Bash(aws ec2 describe-launch-templates *)
Bash(aws ec2 describe-managed-prefix-lists *)
Bash(aws ec2 describe-security-groups *)
Bash(aws ec2 describe-subnets *)
Bash(aws ec2 describe-transit-gateways *)
Bash(aws ec2 describe-vpc-endpoints *)
Bash(aws ec2 describe-vpcs *)
Bash(aws acm describe-certificate *)
Bash(aws cloudformation list-exports *)
Bash(aws cognito-idp describe-user-pool *)
Bash(aws dynamodb describe-table *)
Bash(aws ecr describe-images *)
Bash(aws ecr describe-repositories *)
Bash(aws elbv2 describe-listeners *)
Bash(aws elbv2 describe-load-balancers *)
Bash(aws elbv2 describe-target-groups *)
Bash(aws events describe-event-bus *)
Bash(aws iam get-instance-profile *)
Bash(aws iam get-policy *)
Bash(aws iam get-role *)
Bash(aws kms describe-key *)
Bash(aws kms list-aliases *)
Bash(aws lambda get-layer-version *)
Bash(aws logs describe-log-groups *)
Bash(aws route53 get-hosted-zone *)
Bash(aws route53 list-hosted-zones-by-name *)
Bash(aws s3api get-bucket-location *)
Bash(aws sns get-topic-attributes *)
Bash(aws sqs get-queue-url *)
